_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking the crew's pay against the WD…

description: Use when the user wants to know whether each worker on a Davis-Bacon job was paid at least the WD rate for a payroll week. For every worker and classification it computes the base and fringe due vs. paid, recomputes overtime (hours over 40 in the workweek, 29 CFR 5.5(b)(1) and 5.32), checks apprentice registration and the daily apprentice ratio (29 CFR 5.5(a)(4)), and totals the restitution owed, each amount with its CFR citation; also returns the WH-347 lines as paid. Up to 50 workers. Either pass the pasted WD text (wdText) and link each segment to a row with wdRowId (from get_wage_rates on the same text), or give the WD rate of each segment directly (rate) as the user reads it in the contract. Example: wdText="General Decision Number: TX20260291 …", weekEnding="2026-06-07", workers=[{name:"Crew 1", segments:[{classification:"Welder", wdRowId:"r1", stByDay:[8,8,8,8,8], paidBaseRate:22}]}].

wdText.description: Full text of the general wage determination, pasted by the user from the contract or from the sam.gov page, from "General Decision Number" to "END OF GENERAL DECISION", line breaks kept (max 400000 characters). Pass the same text again in later calls so rowId values stay valid.

weekEnding.description: Last day of the payroll week.

pctOfJourneyworker.description: Program wage as a fraction of the journeyworker base, e.g. 0.6.

hoursRecordedByClassification.description: Payroll records show the hours in each classification.

segments.description: One entry per classification worked this week.

cashInLieuRate.description: Cash paid in lieu of fringe, $/h.

classification.description: Classification worked, as the user names it.

otByDay.description: Overtime hours paid, Monday to Sunday.

paidBaseRate.description: Cash hourly rate paid, excluding cash in lieu of fringe.

paidFringe.description: Fringe contributions paid to each plan, $/h.

paidOtRate.description: Rate paid for overtime hours; default paidBaseRate x 1.5.

rate.description: WD rate to use when there is no WD row (e.g. conformed classification).

stByDay.description: Straight-time hours paid, Monday to Sunday.

wdRowId.description: rowId from get_wage_rates on the same wdText (preferred).

name: check_crew_pay

origin.description: Rates come from the WD text pasted by the user; nothing is fetched.

revision.description: Last modification listed in the pasted text.

samUrl.description: Public sam.gov page of this WD, for the user to check the text.

title: Check a crew's pay against the wage determination
